question.html:
Consider the following statements:

I. Newton’s laws of motion are the same in all inertial reference frames.

II. Two observers in two different inertial reference frames will always agree on the lenght of a given object.

III. The speed of light in vacuum is the same in all inertial reference frames.

Which of these statements are correct, according to the principles of special relativity?

  1. I and II only
  2. I and III only
  3. II and III only
  4. I, II and III
